ignoreRuleReasons.codex-grid-background: The fine rule grid is StandX's visual language, not AI slop. It is the background treatment on standx-stats.vercel.app and is reproduced here deliberately: a 52px white grid, a 260px green grid at 5x that pitch, and a dot on the coarse intersections, over a flat base. Dismissed on the same grounds as dark-glow in the 2026-07-27 critique, where every hit was the locked green-on-near-black brand this project has committed to.
